# SmartPatrol by CloudGen Technologies

> AI-powered smart patrol solutions for workforce management, QR checkpoint patrolling, incident management, visitor & vehicle access, and enterprise security operations.

Site: https://smartpatrol.asia
Company: https://cloudgentechnologies.com/
App: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.guards.app

## Product modules
- Smart Patrol: geofence & face biometric workforce attendance
- Smart Patrolling: QR checkpoint scans, digital checklists, WhatsApp/IVR incident tickets
- Smart Gate: visitor/vehicle ID capture, QR passes, blacklist/whitelist, SOS
- Enterprise Suite: centralized multi-site operations, CCTV AI options, audit reporting

## Commercial
- Plans: Base, Pro, Gold (EUR pricing model aligned with standard guard-tour packages)
- From 2.64 / 5.07 / 9.53 EUR per guard / month
- Guard slider 1–100; >100 requires quote
- Annual billing includes about 15% off
- Checkout via Razorpay (INR)
